name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: PM-KISAN is a Central Sector Scheme providing direct income support to landholding farmer families across India to supplement their financial needs for agricultural inputs and domestic requirements.
benefits_summary: Direct cash transfer of ₹6,000 per financial year released in 3 equal four-monthly installments of ₹2,000 each directly into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts.
eligibility_summary: All landholding farmer families with cultivable landholding in their names. Exclusions apply for institutional landholders, holding constitutional posts, retired or serving government employees, pension > ₹10,000/month, and income-tax payers.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card (Mandatory)
Land Ownership Documents (Record of Rights / RoR / Pahani / Khata certificate)
Aadhaar-seeded Active Bank Account Passbook with IFSC
Valid Mobile Number linked to Aadhaar
Self-declaration of non-exclusion criteria
application_steps: 1. Visit the official PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) or visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC).
2. Click on 'Farmer Corner' and select 'New Farmer Registration'.
3. Enter Aadhaar number, state, and mobile number to receive OTP.
4. Fill out land details including Survey/Khasra number, Dag/Khata number, and land area.
5. Upload required land record and Aadhaar copy.
6. Complete e-KYC using Aadhaar OTP or biometric authentication at CSC.
7. Submit the application and note the registration reference number.
deadline: Ongoing enrollment / Open throughout the year

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: AB-PMJAY is the world's largest government-funded health assurance scheme, providing a financial safety net against catastrophic health expenditures for vulnerable and low-income families.
benefits_summary: Health insurance cover of up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization across all empaneled public and private hospitals across India.
eligibility_summary: Families listed in the Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) 2011 database, NFSA ration card holders, and senior citizens aged 70+ (under expanded Ayushman Vay Vandana). No restriction on family size, age, or gender.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card (Primary identity verification)
Ration Card (BPL / Antyodaya / State Food Security Card)
Family ID / SECC confirmation letter
Active Mobile number for OTP verification
application_steps: 1. Check eligibility on 'beneficiary.nha.gov.in' using mobile number or Ration Card number.
2. Locate nearest Empaneled Health Care Provider (EHCP) hospital or Ayushman Seva Kendra / CSC.
3. Meet the Ayushman Mitra at the hospital helpdesk.
4. Complete e-KYC verification using Aadhaar biometric or OTP.
5. Download or print the Ayushman Card instantly upon approval.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
description: PMMY provides institutional collateral-free loans to micro and small non-farm, non-corporate enterprises to foster entrepreneurship and self-employment.
benefits_summary: Collateral-free business loans categorized into Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakhs), and Tarun (₹5 Lakhs to ₹10 Lakhs, extendable up to ₹20 Lakhs for established borrowers).
eligibility_summary: Any Indian citizen with a viable business plan for manufacturing, processing, trading, or service sector. Age must be at least 18 years. Applicant must not have defaulted with any bank or financial institution.
required_documents: Mudra Loan Application Form
Identity Proof: Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, PAN Card, or Passport
Proof of Residence: Utility bill, Voter ID, or Rental agreement
Business Address and Proof of Establishment (Udyam Registration / Shop Act License)
Bank Account Statements for past 6 months
Quotation of machinery/raw materials to be purchased
Passport size photographs (2 copies)
application_steps: 1. Prepare a project report / business plan detailing fund requirements.
2. Apply online via Udyami Mitra portal (udyamimitra.in) or JanSamarth portal (jansamarth.in).
3. Alternatively, approach any Commercial Bank, RRB, Small Finance Bank, or MFI.
4. Submit the MUDRA application form along with business registration and quotation documents.
5. Bank scrutinizes proposal and sanctions loan without asking for collateral security.
6. Receive MUDRA Debit Card for working capital withdrawals.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: A micro-credit facility empowering urban, peri-urban, and rural street vendors to restart their livelihoods with affordable working capital loans.
benefits_summary: Initial collateral-free working capital loan of ₹10,000 (1st tranche). Upon timely repayment, enhanced loan of ₹20,000 (2nd tranche) and up to ₹50,000 (3rd tranche). Interest subsidy of 7% per annum on timely repayment, plus cashback of up to ₹1,200/year on digital transactions.
eligibility_summary: Street vendors and hawkers vending in urban areas. Vendors must hold a Certificate of Vending (CoV) / Identity Card issued by Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) or a Letter of Recommendation (LoR).
required_documents: Certificate of Vending (CoV) or Vendor Identity Card issued by ULB/Municipality
Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from Town Vending Committee (if ID is not issued)
Aadhaar Card linked to mobile number
Active Bank Account Passbook
UPI ID / QR code proof for digital payment cashback
application_steps: 1. Verify vendor name in the ULB vendor list or obtain LoR from municipality.
2. Open the PM SVANidhi portal (pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in) or mobile app.
3. Log in using Aadhaar-linked mobile number via OTP.
4. Enter vendor status, LoR/CoV details, and requested loan amount.
5. Select preferred lending institution (Lender).
6. Submit online application. Lending bank verifies and disburses the amount.

name: Centrally Sponsored Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC/ST/OBC Students
department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / Tribal Affairs
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Centrally sponsored scholarship scheme to financially assist meritorious and underprivileged SC, ST, and OBC students pursuing post-matriculation or post-secondary education.
benefits_summary: 100% reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable college/university fees, plus monthly maintenance allowance up to ₹13,500/annum for hostellers and ₹7,000/annum for day scholars, book grants, and study tour allowances.
financial_amount: Full Tuition Fee + up to ₹13,500/year allowance
eligibility_summary: Indian national belonging to SC, ST, or OBC category. Must have passed matriculation (Class 10) or higher exam and be enrolled in a recognized university, college, or polytechnic. Total annual family income from all sources must not exceed ₹2,50,000 per annum.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card (Aadhaar seeding with bank account is mandatory)
Caste Certificate issued by competent government revenue authority
Income Certificate issued by Tehsildar / Revenue Officer (valid for current year)
Previous Qualifying Examination Marksheet
Current Year College Admission Fee Receipt / Bonafide Certificate
Bank Passbook with clearly visible IFSC and Account Number
application_steps: 1. Navigate to the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
2. Register using Aadhaar and mobile number to obtain OTR (One Time Registration).
3. Log in with OTR credentials and select 'Post Matric Scholarship Scheme'.
4. Enter academic, caste, and income details.
5. Upload scanned copies of marksheet, income certificate, caste certificate, and fee receipt.
6. Submit online application and submit printed copy to college nodal officer for institute-level verification.
deadline: Annually October - December (Check NSP portal for current session)

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY - Urban / Gramin)
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs & Ministry of Rural Development
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: PMAY aims to achieve 'Housing for All' by providing pucca houses with basic amenities (water, sanitation, electricity) to homeless and eligible families living in kutcha dwellings.
benefits_summary: Gramin: Direct financial assistance of ₹1,20,000 (plains) to ₹1,30,000 (hilly/difficult areas) + 90/95 days of unskilled labor wage under MGNREGS. Urban: Interest subsidy up to ₹2.67 Lakhs on home loans for EWS/LIG under Credit Linked Subsidy.
eligibility_summary: Homeless families or families residing in zero, one, or two-room houses with kutcha wall and roof (based on SECC/Awas+ data). Beneficiary family must not own a pucca house anywhere in India. Woman head of household must be sole or joint owner.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of all adult family members
Ration Card / BPL card
Bank Account details linked with Aadhaar
Job Card number under MGNREGS (for PMAY-G)
Sworn affidavit confirming no pucca house ownership in India
Land ownership title or site allotment deed
application_steps: 1. For PMAY-G: Gram Sabha verifies eligible list from Awas+ survey database.
2. For PMAY-U: Visit pmaymis.gov.in, go to 'Citizen Assessment' and enter Aadhaar.
3. Fill applicant profile, present address, permanent address, and family member details.
4. Upload bank passbook and affidavit.
5. Geo-tagging of existing kutcha structure and stages of construction (foundation, plinth, lintel, roof).
6. Funds released in direct installments linked to construction geo-tag milestones.

name: Karnataka Gruha Lakshmi Scheme
department: Department of Women and Child Development
description: One of the flagship guarantee schemes of the Karnataka Government providing monthly direct financial assistance to the woman designated as head of the family in food security ration cards.
benefits_summary: Direct benefit cash transfer of ₹2,000 per month deposited every month into the Aadhaar-seeded bank account of the eligible woman head of household.
eligibility_summary: The woman must be identified as head of the family ('Yajamaki') on Antyodaya (AAY), BPL, or APL ration cards issued by Karnataka Food and Civil Supplies Department. Both the woman and her husband must NOT be Income Tax payees or GST filers. Must be a permanent resident of Karnataka.
required_documents: Karnataka Ration Card (BPL / Antyodaya / APL) with applicant listed as Family Head
Aadhaar Card of the woman applicant
Aadhaar Card of the applicant's husband
Aadhaar-linked Bank Account Passbook
Mobile number linked to Aadhaar (for OTP verification)
application_steps: 1. Check the SMS notification or visit Grama One, Karnataka One, or Bangalore One centres.
2. Alternatively, apply online via Seva Sindhu Guarantee Scheme Portal (sevasindhugs.karnataka.gov.in).
3. Provide Ration Card number; the portal fetches family details automatically.
4. Enter applicant's Aadhaar and husband's Aadhaar number.
5. Complete Aadhaar biometric or OTP authentication.
6. Confirm self-declaration that neither spouse is an Income Tax or GST payer.
7. Collect the computer-generated acknowledgment slip.

name: Karnataka Yuva Nidhi Scheme
department: Department of Skill Development, Entrepreneurship and Livelihood
description: Unemployment assistance scheme of the Government of Karnataka to support educated youth during their job search and skill training transition period.
benefits_summary: Monthly unemployment financial aid of ₹3,000 for unemployed Degree holders and ₹1,500 for unemployed Diploma holders for a maximum period of 2 years or until gaining employment / self-employment.
eligibility_summary: Must be a permanent resident of Karnataka (domicile of minimum 6 years). Must have graduated or obtained diploma in recognized universities/institutions within Karnataka. Must have completed 180 days (6 months) of unemployment post-graduation. Must NOT be employed in govt/private sector, self-employed, or pursuing full-time higher studies.
required_documents: Degree or Diploma Completion Certificate / Convocation Certificate
All semester marksheets / Marks cards
10th standard SSLC marks card (proof of age/name)
Karnataka Domicile Proof (Study certificate for at least 6 years in Karnataka or Domicile Certificate)
Aadhaar Card linked to Bank Account (DBT-enabled)
Unemployment Self-declaration affidavit
application_steps: 1. Visit the Seva Sindhu Yuva Nidhi portal (sevasindhugs.karnataka.gov.in).
2. Log in using Aadhaar number and OTP.
3. Enter University / Board registration number to fetch degree or diploma credentials from NAD/DigiLocker.
4. Upload Karnataka study certificate (minimum 6 years).
5. Verify Aadhaar-seeded bank account for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
6. Submit the online self-declaration affirming unemployed status.
7. Submit mandatory monthly self-declaration on portal to continue receiving benefits.
deadline: Open enrollment for eligible graduation batches

name: Karnataka Gruha Jyothi Scheme
description: Karnataka guarantee scheme providing free domestic electricity up to 200 units per month to all residential households in Karnataka to alleviate household utility burdens.
benefits_summary: Zero electricity bill if monthly consumption is within the entitlement limit (calculated based on individual 12-month average consumption + 10% extra, subject to an overall ceiling of 200 units).
financial_amount: Up to 200 Units Free Electricity / Month
eligibility_summary: All domestic/residential electricity consumers in Karnataka (BESCOM, MESCOM, HESCOM, GESCOM, CESC). Applies to one meter per customer/household. Tenants are also eligible with rental agreement or voter card matching address. Commercial connections are strictly excluded.
required_documents: Electricity Bill / Consumer Account ID (Account ID / Connection ID / RR Number)
Aadhaar Card of the applicant
Rental agreement or Voter ID (for tenants living in rented accommodation)
Mobile number for OTP authentication
application_steps: 1. Open Seva Sindhu Gruha Jyothi portal (sevasindhugs.karnataka.gov.in).
2. Select Electricity Supply Company (ESCOM): BESCOM, MESCOM, HESCOM, GESCOM, or CESC.
3. Enter the 10-digit Account ID printed on electricity bill.
4. Indicate whether applicant is an Owner or Tenant.
5. Enter Aadhaar number and verify with OTP.
6. Submit application and download the acknowledgment slip. Subsidy applies from next billing cycle.

name: Karnataka Shakti Scheme
description: Empowerment initiative offering free public bus transit across Karnataka to all women, student girls, and transgender persons to boost mobility and workforce participation.
benefits_summary: 100% free travel in ordinary, express, city, and suburban buses operated by all 4 state road transport corporations (KSRTC, BMTC, NWKRTC, KKRTC) within Karnataka state boundaries.
eligibility_summary: All women, girl students, and transgender persons who are permanent residents of Karnataka. Valid on all non-luxury buses (ordinary, suburban, Suvarna, Nagara Sarige, Express). Luxury buses (Airavat, Rajahamsa, EV Club Class, Ambari) and interstate trips outside Karnataka are excluded.
required_documents: Any government-issued Photo ID card proving Karnataka residence (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID Card, Driving License, or Shakti Smart Card)
application_steps: 1. Board any eligible state transport bus (KSRTC, BMTC, NWKRTC, KKRTC).
2. Present valid government photo ID card showing Karnataka address to the conductor.
3. Conductor issues a 'Zero Fare' ticket (Shakti Ticket).
4. (Optional) Apply online on Seva Sindhu for the Shakti Smart Card.

name: Karnataka SSP Post-Matric Scholarship & Vidyasiri Scheme
department: Social Welfare & Backward Classes Welfare Department
description: Comprehensive state scholarship portal integrating fee concession, reimbursement, and Vidyasiri (food and accommodation support) for students belonging to SC, ST, OBC, and Minorities.
benefits_summary: Full college tuition fee reimbursement, exam fee concession, and Vidyasiri monthly allowance of ₹1,500/month for 10 months (₹15,000/year) for students not accommodated in government hostels.
eligibility_summary: Karnataka domicile student enrolled in post-matric studies (Class 11, 12, ITI, Diploma, Degree, Engineering, Medical, Post-Graduate). SC/ST annual income limit up to ₹2.5 Lakhs; Category-1 up to ₹2.5 Lakhs; Categories 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B up to ₹1.0 Lakh. Minimum 75% college attendance.
required_documents: Student SSP ID (created on State Scholarship Portal)
Aadhaar Card of student and parent
Caste & Income Certificate RD Number (from Nadakacheri portal)
College Admission Registration / USN / Student Roll Number
Fee Receipt & Bonafide Certificate
College Hostel Warden Certificate or Paying Guest / House Rental Agreement (for Vidyasiri)
application_steps: 1. Register on Karnataka State Scholarship Portal (ssp.postmatric.karnataka.gov.in).
2. Provide Aadhaar number and consent for e-KYC authentication.
3. Enter Nadakacheri RD number to automatically validate Caste and Income certificate.
4. Enter University Seat Number (USN) or college admission registration number.
5. E-Attestation of document copies by designated college E-attestation officer.
6. Submit online application. Track status and DBT disbursement on SSP portal.
deadline: Annual deadlines published by Dept (usually November - January)

name: Karnataka Raitha Vidya Nidhi Scheme
description: Financial assistance program for children of farmers in Karnataka to encourage rural students to pursue higher and professional education without financial distress.
benefits_summary: Direct annual scholarship ranging from ₹2,000 to ₹11,000 depending on course and gender (High School girls: ₹2,000; PUC/ITI/Diploma: ₹2,500 - ₹3,000; Degree: ₹5,000 - ₹5,500; PG/Medical/Engineering: ₹10,000 - ₹11,000).
eligibility_summary: Children of registered farmers in Karnataka possessing a Farmer Identification (FID) number on the FRUITS portal. Applicable to students studying in class 8th to 10th (girls) and post-matric courses (PUC, Degree, Engineering, Medical, Agriculture, PG).
required_documents: Farmer ID (FID) of Parent from Karnataka FRUITS Portal
Student Aadhaar Card
Parent Aadhaar Card
College Admission Bonafide / Fee Receipt with USN
Aadhaar-seeded Bank Account of student
application_steps: 1. Ensure parent's land is registered on Karnataka FRUITS portal (fruits.karnataka.gov.in) with an FID.
2. Apply via the Karnataka State Scholarship Portal (SSP).
3. In the scholarship application, check the box 'Child of Farmer' and enter Parent's FID.
4. The system validates parent landholder status from FRUITS database.
5. Once verified by the institution, scholarship amount is directly transferred via Aadhaar DBT.
deadline: Synchronized with SSP portal academic calendar
